sentences.text:
Himanshu Sekhar Das and another .... Petitioners
 Mr. J.K. Majhi, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha ....

Opposite Party
 Mr. Manoj Kumar Mohanty, Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice Sashikanta Mishra
 Order
Order No. 19.10.2023
01. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.
3.

The Petitioners are apprehending arrest in connection with I.C.C. Case No.100 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Basta for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 420/467/468/406/427/506/294 and 34 of IPC.

4. It is alleged that on the basis of a complaint lodged by one Sanyasi Charan Das, the learned J.M.F.C., Basta has forwarded the same to the IIC, Basta Police Station for its registration and investigation under Section 156(3) Cr. P.C.
It is alleged that the Petitioners fraudulently managed to alienate a piece of land belonging to the informant and also assaulted him.

5. Considering the above fact and the nature of accusations and also the materials on record, while not being inclined to grant anticipatory bail, the ABLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the Petitioners to surrender before the Court below within a week from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and to move for bail.
In such event, they shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as the Court below may deem fit and proper to impose.
